case.intent: Candidate source truth for16 named mutation categories. Every common-domain operation uses defined arithmetic and in-bounds access; logical-bounds and NULL policy checks deliberately avoid unsafe old-version execution. See README ledger; authored labels are not accepted binary ground truth until checked independently.

functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Unsigned addition literal 17 -> 29; defined for every uint32_t value.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_comparison
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Strict comparison becomes inclusive; distinguishing input value=13.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_bounds_added
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Both versions retain physical 16-byte bounds; v2 adds logical-length rejection. data must designate 16 initialized bytes. No old-version out-of-bounds behavior is claimed.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_bounds_removed
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Remove logical-length rejection while preserving physical 16-byte bounds; same total defined input domain as bounds_added.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_pointer_offset
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Pointer offset 1 -> 2; non-NULL data must designate an array of at least four initialized bytes in both versions.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_array_index
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Index rotates modulo four; uint32 addition wraps before mask, so every index is defined. Same four-byte initialized array domain.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_overflow_guard
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. v1 unsigned wrap is intentional defined behavior; v2 rejects multiplication overflow. count=0x40000000 gives 0 -> UINT32_MAX.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_signedness
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Convert negative int32 to uint32 using defined modulo conversion; delta=-1 gives 1 -> 0. No signed arithmetic or unsigned-to-signed cast.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_allocation_size
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Allocation request via caller callback: 4*count+8 -> 4*count+16 for count<=32, maximum144 bytes. Fixture neither implements allocation nor dereferences returned pointer.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_loop_bound
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Read limit vs limit+1 bytes; limit<=8. Both versions require nine initialized bytes, including count=0; maximum nine loop iterations and sum2295.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_call_target
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Choose primary -> secondary callback slot. Both callbacks must be ABI-compatible, defined and terminating for value; valid descriptor with null slots is rejected. Slot offsets survive address masking more directly than changing a direct call symbol.

functions.label: changed
functions.name: r1_error_handling
functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Failure status previously returned0; v2 returns UINT32_MAX; success path unchanged.

functions.notes: Candidate authored source truth; binary survival pending independent review. Adds policy validation of marker; neither version dereferences it. Defined for NULL or a valid object pointer; NULL,value=7 gives7 -> UINT32_MAX. This is not a formerly unsafe dereference fix.
